GSAP — GreenSock standard "no charge" license
=============================================

Copyright (c) 2008-2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.

GreenSock does not ship a licence file in the `gsap` npm package; its README
states the terms by reference:

    GreenSock's standard "no charge" license can be viewed at
    https://gsap.com/standard-license

The full text therefore lives at that URL and is deliberately not reproduced
here — copying it into this repository would create a second copy that could
drift from the one GreenSock maintains.

What the licence permits, in short: GSAP may be used at no charge on websites
and in applications, including commercial ones. It is not an OSI open-source
licence. What it restricts is redistributing GSAP *itself* as part of a
competing product, or inside a tool that lets other people build animations.

Serving it as part of a website — which is what this repository does, with the
minified files vendored into `../js/` — is exactly what it is for.

Files covered:
  ../js/gsap.min.js
  ../js/ScrollTrigger.min.js
  ../js/SplitText.min.js
